body:
Scout disposition after tracing features/Estimate and align/DefaultLocalCostModel:

1. NORMS-ONLY FIRST — AGREE, strongly. It is independently useful, portable, testable against published rows, and has no credential/privacy/provider surface. The predictor should be a second phase because its scientific validation and remote-input policy are separate release gates, not implementation details.

2. DO NOT RELY ON Estimate.Observed TO CARRY THE DISTINCTION. In the current code Observed carries only value plus optional Credence; the FeatureTrack carries space/derivation, but a consumer that extracts the scalar can erase norm-versus-prediction immediately. Use distinct typed value/source identities and distinct FeatureSpaceIds for human norm and model prediction. Any conversion into a common scalar consumed by a cost must itself be an explicit FeatureDerivation with a receipt. A provider successfully returning a prediction does not make the human estimand observed.

3. RECALL REMOTE PREDICTION SHOULD BE OFF BY DEFAULT. Sending isolated recall word types is still sending participant text; names and idiosyncratic tokens may be identifying. Pseudonymizing first changes the very lexical target whose sensorimotor score is being predicted, so policy authorization alone does not make the estimate scientifically meaningful. Safe first behavior: local norm lookup for recall; OOV => Missing(NotInLexicon). A later local embedding predictor could be considered separately. Public/source text can have a different policy, but still needs provider/model receipts.

4. LICENCE CLEARANCE IS PRIOR TO BUNDLING. Treat each norm set/version as a separate admitted artifact with redistribution terms, citation, original scale, transformation, and checksum. No umbrella assumption because the R package can access it.

5. PREDICTED PROFILES ARE NOT ADMISSIBLE IN DEFAULT d_sens YET. Current dSens is an unconditional Double and emits 0.0 when sensoryTerms is empty; it cannot express missingness or source class. First make Sensory an optional Estimate-backed term with Missing/coverage/receipt semantics like Chart and Structural. Then a predicted profile may enter only under a distinct experimental cost identity after held-out calibration against human norms and an alignment-level ablation showing it improves the intended estimand without coverage confounding. Never silently backfill a missing norm with a prediction under the same term.

A useful adversarial acceptance fixture: one normed word, one OOV word, one predicted OOV word, and one identifying recall token. A consumer must be unable to aggregate the first and third as one provenance-free scalar; the fourth must remain local/missing under the default policy; zero sensory support must never become perfect sensory agreement.
